FORM NO. 3
G. 101/35P

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No....................
Special Branch - Station 7594
REPORT
Date November 5, 1936.

Subject (in full) Stepan STANISKO, change of nationality.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. [Signature]

With reference to the attached advertisement appearing
in the "Shun Pao" of October 27, 1936 in which a person named
"S-Dan-Ni-Z-Ko S-Ti-Ben" (史丹尼士哥司地朋 ), gives notice of
the fact that he has acquired Chinese nationality, I have to
report that this individual's correct name is Stepan STANISKO.
He was formerly a Greek gypsy and followed the calling of a
musician, playing in various third-class cabarets in French
Town. He has come to the notice of the Settlement Police on
one occasion before, when in June 1932 he was arrested by Louza
Station on suspicion of having participated with another
gypsy in obtaining $85 from the Wing On Company by larceny by
trick (ringing the changes), but owing to lack of evidence he
was released. (Louza FIR 1300/32).

When applying to the Bureau of Public Safety for his
new papers Stanisko gave his address as 515 Route Vallon, but
enquiries indicate that he is not residing there at present.

(印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 5 NOV 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE)

D.S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

(批：DMR / 5/11)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号....................
特别分部 - 第7594号站
报告
日期：1936年11月5日。

主题（全称）：斯捷潘·斯坦尼斯科（Stepan STANISKO），变更国籍。

制作人：D.S. Pitts。转呈人：J. [签名]

鉴于附件中刊登于1936年10月27日《申报》的一则广告，其中一名名为“史丹尼士哥司地朋”（S-Dan-Ni-Z-Ko S-Ti-Ben）的人声明其已取得中国国籍，本人特此报告，该人的正确姓名为斯捷潘·斯坦尼斯科（Stepan STANISKO）。他原是一名希腊吉普赛人，职业为乐师，曾在法租界各三等歌舞厅演奏。此人此前曾引起租界警方注意，当时在1932年6月，他因涉嫌与另一名吉普赛人合谋，通过掉包诈骗手段（ringing the changes）从永安公司骗取85美元，而被老闸捕房逮捕，但因证据不足获释。（老闸捕房案件记录 1300/32）。

斯坦尼斯科在向公安局申请新证件时，提供的地址为瓦隆路515号，但调查显示他目前并未居住于此。

（印章：特别分部 / 1936年11月5日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

D.S.
副总监（特别分部）。

（批注：DMR / 11月5日）

O. 1/6 S. B

October 27, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

A CHANGE OF NATIONALITY

(史唐尼士哥·司的明) A person named "S-Dah-Ni-Z-Ko S-Ti-Ben"
"Shun Pao" :- publishes the following notice in today's
"I have received the following notification
from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau:-
'Your application for Chinese
citizenship was referred to the Shanghai City Govern-
ment which in turn referred it to the Ministry of
Interior. The Ministry of Interior finds that your
application conforms with the provisions of the
Nationality Law and has sent to the Shanghai City
Government a certificate No. 85, Character "Hung" (洪),
to be issued to you. On instructions of the City
Government, this Bureau now informs you as above and
instructs that you insert a notice in two local
newspapers announcing your change of nationality.'
"I hereby insert this notice as instructed
by the Public Safety Bureau."

The National Herald and other local newspapers :-

THE ABOLITION OF TIPPING

In an interview with a reporter of the
Ta Kung News Agency the other day, Mr. Chiang Au (姜 靄),
Secretary of the New Life Movement Acceleration Association,
said: "In view of the difficulties attending the abolition
of tipping, this Association intends to petition the New
Life Movement Federation not to enforce the order in
Shanghai for the time being."

SUNG SING NO. 2 AND NO. 5 MILLS TO RESUME OPERATIONS

The Sung Sing No. 2 Cotton Mill on Ichang
Road and No. 5 Cotton Mill on Ward Road will soon resume
work under the joint management of the Bank of China and the
Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank. The two banks have
established a Control Committee and have appointed Mr.
Yung Er Zung (榮 爾 仁) to take charge of the two mills.
Yesterday morning Mr. Yung attended the
Sung Sing No. 2 Mill to supervise the registration of
workers and to make other arrangements for resumption of
work. The registration of male and female workers for the
No. 2 Mill, of whom over 2,000 will be required, will be
open from October 26 to October 28. The mill will start
working on October 29.
The date on which the No. 5 Mill will
resume operations will be decided later.

TRAITORS IN NORTH KIANGSU

Of late a number of traitors have come to
North Kiangsu disguised as monks or nuns to secure in-
formation. The various hsien authorities are paying close
attention to them and have detailed officers to locate and
arrest them.

O. 1/6 S. B

1936年10月27日。下午译文。

变更国籍

（史唐尼士哥·司的明）一名名为“史达尼兹科·斯蒂本”（S-Dah-Ni-Z-Ko S-Ti-Ben）的人在今天的《申报》上刊登如下通告：
“本人收到上海公安局以下通知：
‘你申请加入中国国籍一事，已转呈上海市政府，市政府又将其转呈内政部。内政部认为你的申请符合《国籍法》之规定，并已向上海市政府签发第85号‘洪’字证书，以便发给你。奉市政府指令，本局现如上通知你，并指示你在两家本地报纸上刊登公告，宣布你变更国籍。’
“本人谨遵公安局指示，刊登此公告。”

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

废除小费

新生活运动促进会秘书姜霭先生日前在接受大公通讯社记者采访时称：“鉴于废除小费面临诸多困难，本会拟向新生活运动联合会请愿，暂不在上海强制执行该项命令。”

崇信二厂和五厂恢复运营

位于宜昌路的崇信第二棉纺厂和位于华德路的第五棉纺厂，将在中国银行和上海商业储蓄银行的联合管理下不久恢复生产。两家银行已成立监理委员会，并委任荣尔仁先生负责管理这两家工厂。
昨天上午，荣先生前往崇信二厂监督工人登记工作，并为复工做其他安排。二厂男女工人的登记工作将于10月26日至10月28日开放，预计需招募2000余人。该厂将于10月29日开工。
五厂恢复运营的具体日期将稍后决定。

江苏北部的汉奸

近期，数名汉奸伪装成和尚或尼姑潜入江苏北部以获取情报。各县当局正密切关注他们，并已派遣专员进行搜捕。
